tokens.name: volt
tokens.usage: Volt primary, solid. The centre of the Volt blend. Single-colour marks, icons, focus ring, selected state, first chart series, diagram icons. 3.9:1 on panel and 4.2:1 on Paper: graphics and large text only. Words use volt-text.

tokens.name: volt-start
tokens.usage: Volt Blue. The light end of the Volt blend (top-left of every gradient).

tokens.name: volt-end
tokens.usage: Volt Indigo. The deep end of the Volt blend (bottom-right). Also "Streaming" in the wordmark on Paper.

tokens.name: volt-strong
tokens.usage: Filled primary buttons, filled tags and CTA shapes, with on-volt text (6.3:1).

tokens.name: volt-text
tokens.usage: Links, eyebrows and blue words on ground and panel (6.8:1 Control room, 5.9:1 Paper).

tokens.name: volt-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a selected row, an info banner or the Volt group in a diagram. Text on it stays ink.

tokens.name: on-volt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on volt-strong and on the Volt blend.

tokens.name: current
tokens.usage: "Streaming" in the wordmark on Control room, the second chart series. Never a button. 7.1:1 on panel (Control room).

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and slide background. Control room is the default for product, web and marketing, Paper for documents and print.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards, diagram nodes, slide panels, the lower-third bar.

tokens.name: panel-2
tokens.usage: Inputs and nested surfaces inside a panel.

tokens.name: panel-3
tokens.usage: Chips, type tags, badge fills, hover wash.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panels and table rows.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen: diagram nodes and group boundaries, the co-branding divider.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the "Volt" word in the lockup, on ground, panel and panel-2 (15.9:1 Control room).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, decks, meta lines and diagram detail lines, on ground and every panel (5.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative meta at 12px or larger and secondary connectors. 3.6:1 on panel in Control room: below AA, kept to match the shipped UI. Use ink-muted for anything that must be read.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Status: on air, healthy, passing. Always with its word and a dot.

tokens.name: sched
tokens.usage: Status: ready, scheduled, starting.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Status: degraded, needs attention.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Status: error, off air unexpectedly, failed. Told apart from live by its word and position, never hue alone.

tokens.name: idle
tokens.usage: Status: stopped, idle, not configured. A dot or mark only (3.5:1 Control room).

tokens.name: filler
tokens.usage: Slates, filler and loop content on timelines and EPG blocks.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline on web and 16:9 ads. Width 112. One per layout.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Slide title on a title slide, social headline. Width 112.
styles.sample: Every live hour becomes a library.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Section openers on the web, content slide titles. Width 112.
styles.sample: Turn your archive into a channel.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Card and feature headlines, small ad formats.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a headline, diagram group labels. Width 112, in volt-text or ink-muted.

styles.name: deck
styles.usage: One-line standfirst under a headline, in ink-muted.
styles.sample: Record every channel as it airs and publish clips while the match is still on.

styles.name: doc-title
styles.usage: Document and proposal title.

styles.name: doc-h1
styles.usage: Section heading.

styles.name: doc-h2
styles.usage: Subsection heading.

styles.name: doc-h3
styles.usage: Minor heading, table titles.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.usage: Running text in documents and on the web.
styles.sample: When the primary input drops, Volt switches to the backup within one segment and logs the switch on the channel timeline.

styles.name: doc-caption
styles.usage: Captions, footnotes, table text, in ink-muted.
styles.sample: Figure 2. Signal path for a live event with a backup encoder.

styles.name: ui-h1
styles.usage: Page and entity title in the product.

styles.name: ui-h2
styles.usage: Card headings and modal titles.

styles.name: ui-h3
styles.usage: Sub-headings and stat values.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.usage: Body, buttons, inputs and sub-lines in the product. Diagram node labels at 600.
styles.sample: Recording starts when the channel goes on air.

styles.name: ui-sm
styles.usage: Dense body and table cells.

styles.name: ui-tag
styles.usage: Status pills and type tags, uppercase.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels in cards.

styles.name: ui-micro
styles.usage: Meta text, gate detail, timeline ruler ticks.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Timecode, durations, clocks. Always HH:MM:SS:FF.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, API examples, stream URLs and keys.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Protocol tags, IDs in tables, diagram detail lines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a tag, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to text in buttons, gap between pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields, list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (dense), grid gutters, minimum page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding in the product.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards, between diagram nodes.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a page, slide inner padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Safe area on social and ad formats, between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Slide margins at 1920 wide, hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Progress bars, timeline clips, ruler ticks, the lower-third square.

tokens.name: radius-ctl
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, the CTA shape.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, entity thumbs, diagram nodes.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, marketing blocks, diagram group boundaries.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, type tags, protocol tags.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The only shadow. Cards and floating panels on ground.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: Under the app tile. Neutral, never a coloured glow.

gradient.note: The Volt blend, taken from the app tile. Use it on the mark, the app tile and one hero block per layout. Never behind body text.

tokens.name: volt-blend
tokens.usage: The mark in colour artwork, the app tile, one identity block per layout.

tokens.name: tile-light
tokens.usage: Lighting layer over the blend on the app tile: light from above, shade at the base. Pair with a 1px inner rgba(255,255,255,0.16) edge.
